description: This file contains implementation of a CWMP plugin service, including process control, port management, and configuration handling for a device management system.

methods.name: cwmp_timer_cb
methods.description: Callback for timer expiration, initiates starting of cwmpd process.

methods.name: cwmpd_proc_stopped
methods.description: Handles cleanup and restart timer when cwmpd process stops.

methods.name: build_cwmpd_proc_args
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for starting cwmpd process based on environment and config.

methods.name: open_cwmpd_listening_port
methods.description: Configures firewall rules to open port for CWMP connection requests.

methods.name: close_cwmpd_listening_port
methods.description: Removes firewall rules for CWMP connection port.

methods.name: get_cwmpd_subproc
methods.description: Returns the current cwmpd subprocess if running.

methods.name: start_cwmpd
methods.description: Starts the cwmpd process or opens listening port if in standalone mode.

methods.name: stop_cwmpd
methods.description: Stops the cwmpd process or closes listening port if in standalone mode.
